newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 335 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 335 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 335 contracts compared with 1,401 overnight Sunday.
There were 22 wheat, 185 corn, 86 soybean, one soymeal, 28 soyoil, one oat, 11 corn call and one soybean calls were traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/2 cent per bushel lower to 1/2 higher, corn was 1/4 cent higher to 1/4 lower and soybeans were unchanged to 3/4 cent lower.
